subject: Penguin
observations: One large coherent penguin with two eyes, two flippers and two feet on one ice floe beside one substantial fish; no duplicate subjects or grid.

Yellow hat, purple band, red scarf, orange beak/feet/fish fins, turquoise fish and pale-blue floe provide six meaningful color families without counting black animal areas, white belly/background or neighboring blue shades.
Separate hat/pompom, scarf ends, feet and fish fins repeat colors across substantial regions. Broad silhouette and accessories are appropriate for ages 4+.
